title: My School Week
scene: 学哪些科目，哪天上什么，擅长什么

sentences.text: We have five school days, from Monday to Friday.
sentences.gloss: 我们一周上五天学，从星期一到星期五。

sentences.text: We have math on Monday, and we have science on Tuesday.
sentences.gloss: 我们星期一上数学，星期二上科学。

sentences.text: On Wednesday we have English, and I learn many new words.
sentences.gloss: 星期三我们上英语，我学到很多新词。

sentences.text: On Thursday we have art and music, and the lessons are easy for me.
sentences.gloss: 星期四我们上美术和音乐，那些课对我来说很轻松。

sentences.text: On Friday we have history and sport.
sentences.gloss: 星期五我们上历史和体育。

sentences.text: My favorite subject is science, because I want to know how things work.
sentences.gloss: 我最喜欢的科目是科学，因为我想知道东西是怎么运作的。

sentences.text: I am good at English, but math is hard for me.
sentences.gloss: 我英语很好，但数学对我来说很难。

sentences.text: Ben is the best in our class at math, and he helps me every week.
sentences.gloss: 本是我们班数学最好的，他每周都帮我。
